name: Authier
tagline: Open-source password and TOTP vault for browsers and the web
description: Authier is a freemium, early-stage open-source password manager and TOTP vault for browsers and the web. It encrypts vault data on the client before synchronization, supports configurable trusted-device approval and browser autofill, and has not been independently audited. Use an established independently audited password manager for high-value secrets.

features.title: Client-side encrypted sync
features.description: Encrypts vault data in the client before sending it to the synchronization service

features.title: Passwords and TOTP in one vault
features.description: Stores login credentials and time-based one-time password seeds in the same vault

features.title: Browser autofill
features.description: Offers credential and TOTP autofill through the supported browser extensions

features.title: Configurable trusted-device approval
features.description: Can require an already trusted device to approve a newly enrolled device

features.title: Web vault and browser extensions
features.description: Provides a browser-based vault plus extensions for Chrome, Firefox, and Microsoft Edge

features.title: AGPL source
features.description: Publishes the application source under the AGPL-3.0-or-later license

notes.text: Authier is early-stage and has not published an independent security audit. Use an established independently audited password manager for high-value secrets.
Current supported downloads are listed at https://www.authier.pm/download.
